import { createClient } from "npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2.108.0";

// supabase/functions/_shared/linkedin-job-url.ts
function linkedInJobUrl(raw: string): string | null {
  try {
    const value = raw.trim();
    const u = new URL(
      /^(?:www\.)?linkedin\.com\//i.test(value) ? `https://${value}` : value,
    );
    if (
      !["https:", "http:"].includes(u.protocol) ||
      u.username ||
      u.password ||
      u.port ||
      !(u.hostname === "linkedin.com" || u.hostname.endsWith(".linkedin.com"))
    )
      return null;
    const path = u.pathname.match(
      /^\/(?:comm\/)?jobs\/view\/(?:[^/]*-)?(\d+)\/?$/i,
    );
    const id =
      path?.[1] ??
      (/^\/jobs(?:\/|$)/i.test(u.pathname)
        ? u.searchParams.get("currentJobId")
        : null);
    if (!id || !/^[1-9]\d{0,23}$/.test(id)) return null;
    return `https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/${id}/`;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// supabase/functions/_shared/linkedin-job-details.ts
type JobDetails = {
  role: string;
  organization: string;
  location: string;
  employmentType: string;
  description: string;
  deadline: string;
  postedOn: string;
  validThrough: string;
  salary: string;
};
const empty = (): JobDetails => ({
  role: "",
  organization: "",
  location: "",
  employmentType: "",
  description: "",
  deadline: "",
  postedOn: "",
  validThrough: "",
  salary: "",
});
function plainText(input: unknown, max = 20000): string {
  if (typeof input !== "string") return "";
  const entities: Record<string, string> = {
    amp: "&",
    quot: '"',
    apos: "'",
    nbsp: " ",
    lt: "<",
    gt: ">",
    aring: "å",
    auml: "ä",
    ouml: "ö",
    Aring: "Å",
    Auml: "Ä",
    Ouml: "Ö",
  };
  return input
    .replace(/<(script|style)\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/\1\s*>/gi, "")
    .replace(/<\/?(?:p|div|li|br|h[1-6])\b[^>]*>/gi, "\n")
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "")
    .replace(/&(#x[0-9a-f]+|#\d+|[a-z]+);/gi, (_, e: string) => {
      if (e[0] !== "#") return entities[e] ?? `&${e};`;
      const n =
        e[1].toLowerCase() === "x"
          ? parseInt(e.slice(2), 16)
          : Number(e.slice(1));
      return n > 0 && n <= 0x10ffff && !(n >= 0xd800 && n <= 0xdfff)
        ? String.fromCodePoint(n)
        : "";
    })
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f]/g, "")
    .replace(/[ \t]+/g, " ")
    .replace(/\n\s*\n+/g, "\n\n")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, max);
}
function date(value: unknown) {
  if (typeof value !== "string") return "";
  const m = value.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/)?.[0];
  if (!m) return "";
  const d = new Date(`${m}T12:00:00Z`);
  return Number.isFinite(d.getTime()) && d.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === m
    ? m
    : "";
}
function label(text: string, names: string) {
  return (
    text
      .match(new RegExp(`(?:^|\\n)(?:${names})\\s*:\\s*([^\\n]+)`, "i"))?.[1]
      ?.trim() ?? ""
  );
}
function parseJobPage(html: string, jobId?: string): JobDetails {
  const output = empty(),
    posts: Record<string, any>[] = [];
  let visited = 0;
  const walk = (v: unknown, depth = 0) => {
    if (!v || depth > 12 || ++visited > 2000) return;
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      for (const child of v) walk(child, depth + 1);
      return;
    }
    if (typeof v !== "object") return;
    const o = v as Record<string, any>,
      types = Array.isArray(o["@type"]) ? o["@type"] : [o["@type"]];
    if (
      types.some((t) => typeof t === "string" && /(?:^|\/)JobPosting$/.test(t))
    )
      posts.push(o);
    for (const child of Object.values(o))
      if (child && typeof child === "object") walk(child, depth + 1);
  };
  for (const match of html.matchAll(
    /<script\b[^>]*type\s*=\s*["']application\/ld\+json["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script\s*>/gi,
  )) {
    try {
      walk(JSON.parse(match[1]));
    } catch {
      try {
        walk(JSON.parse(plainText(match[1])));
      } catch {
        /* Not job data. */
      }
    }
  }
  const matchesSingle = (p: Record<string, any>) => {
    if (!jobId) return true;
    const urlId = String(p.url ?? "").match(
      /\/jobs\/view\/(?:[^/]*-)?(\d+)\/?(?:[?#]|$)/,
    )?.[1];
    const linkedId =
      p.identifier?.name === "LinkedIn"
        ? String(p.identifier?.value ?? "")
        : "";
    return (!urlId || urlId === jobId) && (!linkedId || linkedId === jobId);
  };
  const job =
    posts.find(
      (p) =>
        jobId &&
        (String(p.identifier?.value ?? p.identifier ?? "") === jobId ||
          new RegExp(`/jobs/view/(?:[^/]*-)?${jobId}/?(?:[?#]|$)`).test(
            String(p.url ?? ""),
          )),
    ) ?? (posts.length === 1 && matchesSingle(posts[0]) ? posts[0] : undefined);
  if (job) {
    output.role = plainText(job.title, 200);
    output.organization = plainText(job.hiringOrganization?.name, 200);
    output.description = plainText(job.description);
    output.postedOn = date(job.datePosted);
    output.validThrough = date(job.validThrough);
    output.deadline = date(job.applicationDeadline);
    const locations = Array.isArray(job.jobLocation)
      ? job.jobLocation
      : [job.jobLocation];
    output.location = [
      ...new Set(
        locations
          .map((l: any) => {
            const a = l?.address;
            if (!a) return "";
            return [
              a.addressLocality,
              a.addressRegion,
              typeof a.addressCountry === "string"
                ? a.addressCountry
                : a.addressCountry?.name,
            ]
              .map((v) => plainText(v, 150))
              .filter(Boolean)
              .join(", ");
          })
          .filter(Boolean),
      ),
    ]
      .join(" · ")
      .slice(0, 500);
    if (job.jobLocationType === "TELECOMMUTE")
      output.location = ["Distans", output.location]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" · ");
    const names: Record<string, string> = {
      FULL_TIME: "Heltid",
      PART_TIME: "Deltid",
      CONTRACTOR: "Konsultuppdrag",
      TEMPORARY: "Tidsbegränsad",
      INTERN: "Praktik",
      INTERNSHIP: "Praktik",
      VOLUNTEER: "Ideellt",
      PER_DIEM: "Behovsanställning",
      OTHER: "Annat",
    };
    output.employmentType = (
      Array.isArray(job.employmentType)
        ? job.employmentType
        : [job.employmentType]
    )
      .filter((v: unknown) => typeof v === "string")
      .map((v: string) => names[v] ?? plainText(v, 100))
      .join(", ")
      .slice(0, 300);
    const salary = job.baseSalary,
      value = salary?.value;
    if (value && typeof value === "object") {
      const amount =
        typeof value.value === "number"
          ? String(value.value)
          : [value.minValue, value.maxValue]
              .filter((v: unknown) => typeof v === "number")
              .join("–");
      if (amount)
        output.salary = [
          amount,
          plainText(salary.currency, 10),
          plainText(value.unitText, 30),
        ]
          .filter(Boolean)
          .join(" ");
    }
  }
  if (!output.role)
    output.role = plainText(
      html.match(/<h1\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1\s*>/i)?.[1],
      200,
    );
  if (!output.organization)
    output.organization = plainText(
      html.match(
        /<a\b[^>]*class\s*=\s*["'][^"']*topcard__org-name-link[^"']*["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a\s*>/i,
      )?.[1],
      200,
    );
  if (!output.description)
    output.description = plainText(
      html.match(
        /<div\b[^>]*class\s*=\s*["'][^"']*show-more-less-html__markup[^"']*["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/div\s*>/i,
      )?.[1],
    );
  const text = plainText(html);
  if (!output.role)
    output.role = label(text, "Tjänst|Titel|Jobbtitel|Job title").slice(0, 200);
  if (!output.organization)
    output.organization = label(
      text,
      "Arbetsgivare|Organisation|Företag|Company",
    ).slice(0, 200);
  if (!output.location)
    output.location = label(text, "Ort|Plats|Location").slice(0, 500);
  if (!output.deadline)
    output.deadline = date(
      label(
        output.description || text,
        "Sista ansökningsdag|Ansök senast|Application deadline",
      ),
    );
  if (!/<[a-z]/i.test(html) && !output.description) output.description = text;
  if (
    /^(?:linkedin|sign in|logga in|join linkedin|registrera dig|this job is no longer available|jobbet finns inte längre)$/i.test(
      output.role,
    )
  )
    output.role = "";
  return output;
}

// supabase/functions/_shared/linkedin-job-handler.ts
async function boundedText(
  body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array> | null,
  max: number,
) {
  if (!body) return "";
  const reader = body.getReader(),
    chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.byteLength;
      if (size > max) throw new Error("Response too large");
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    await reader.cancel().catch(() => {});
  }
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    bytes.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.length;
  }
  return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
}
function linkedInJobHandler(options: {
  origin: string;
  authenticate: (token: string) => Promise<string | null>;
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
  now?: () => number;
}) {
  const recent = new Map<string, { start: number; count: number }>(),
    request = options.fetch ?? fetch;
  return async (req: Request): Promise<Response> => {
    const headers = {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": options.origin,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers":
        "authorization, apikey, content-type, x-client-info",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      Vary: "Origin",
    };
    const reply = (status: number, code: string, message: string) =>
      new Response(JSON.stringify({ code, error: message }), {
        status,
        headers,
      });
    if (
      req.headers.get("origin") &&
      req.headers.get("origin") !== options.origin
    )
      return reply(403, "origin", "Otillåtet ursprung.");
    if (req.method === "OPTIONS")
      return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers });
    if (req.method !== "POST") return reply(405, "method", "Använd POST.");
    let user: string | null = null;
    try {
      user = await options.authenticate(
        req.headers.get("authorization")?.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, "") ?? "",
      );
    } catch {
      /* Invalid session. */
    }
    if (!user)
      return reply(
        401,
        "auth",
        "Logga in i Veckoverket för att läsa annonsen.",
      );
    const now = (options.now ?? Date.now)();
    for (const [id, v] of recent) if (now - v.start >= 60000) recent.delete(id);
    const usage = recent.get(user);
    if (usage && usage.count >= 60)
      return reply(
        429,
        "limit",
        "För många hämtningar. Vänta en minut och försök igen.",
      );
    if (!usage) {
      if (recent.size >= 1000)
        return reply(429, "limit", "Tjänsten är upptagen. Försök senare.");
      recent.set(user, { start: now, count: 1 });
    } else usage.count++;
    let url: string | null;
    try {
      const body = JSON.parse(await boundedText(req.body, 4096));
      url = typeof body.url === "string" ? linkedInJobUrl(body.url) : null;
    } catch {
      return reply(400, "input", "Ange en giltig LinkedIn-länk till ett jobb.");
    }
    if (!url)
      return reply(400, "input", "Ange en giltig LinkedIn-länk till ett jobb.");
    try {
      let target = url;
      const signal = AbortSignal.timeout(12000);
      let response: Response | undefined;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        response = await request(target, {
          redirect: "manual",
          signal,
          headers: {
            Accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml",
            "Accept-Language": "sv,en;q=0.8",
          },
        });
        if (response.status >= 300 && response.status < 400) {
          const location = response.headers.get("location");
          await response.body?.cancel();
          if (!location)
            return reply(422, "blocked", "LinkedIn kunde inte visa annonsen.");
          const next = new URL(location, target);
          if (
            next.protocol !== "https:" ||
            next.hostname !== "www.linkedin.com" ||
            linkedInJobUrl(next.href) !== url
          )
            return reply(
              422,
              "blocked",
              "LinkedIn kräver inloggning eller blockerar läsningen. Klistra in annonstexten i stället.",
            );
          target = next.href;
          continue;
        }
        break;
      }
      if (!response?.ok) {
        await response?.body?.cancel();
        return reply(
          response?.status === 429 ? 429 : 422,
          "blocked",
          "LinkedIn blockerade läsningen eller annonsen finns inte längre. Öppna länken och klistra in annonstexten.",
        );
      }
      const html = await boundedText(response.body, 1500000),
        id = url.match(/\/(\d+)\/$/)![1],
        details = parseJobPage(html, id);
      if (!details.role && !details.organization)
        return reply(
          422,
          "unreadable",
          "Annonsuppgifterna kunde inte läsas. LinkedIn kan kräva inloggning. Klistra in annonstexten i stället.",
        );
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ url, details }), {
        status: 200,
        headers,
      });
    } catch {
      return reply(
        502,
        "fetch",
        "Annonsen kunde inte hämtas inom tidsgränsen. Försök igen eller klistra in annonstexten.",
      );
    }
  };
}

// supabase/functions/linkedin-job/index.ts
const client = createClient(
  Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL")!,
  Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY")!,
  { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } },
);
Deno.serve(
  linkedInJobHandler({
    origin: Deno.env.get("APP_ORIGIN") || "https://andycdn.github.io",
    async authenticate(token) {
      if (!token) return null;
      const { data, error } = await client.auth.getUser(token);
      return !error && data.user && !data.user.is_anonymous
        ? data.user.id
        : null;
    },
  }),
);
